chapter: Armstrong, Parker and life inside the Basie band
title: Why Basie fired Lester Young
summary: Tate offers rumors about the Friday the 13th and John Hammond, but says nobody knows.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: You know, that's the $64 question. Everybody wondered and I've heard different things and I just don't believe it. I don't know. I really don't know because somebody said it was a Friday the 13th and Lester said his something told him not to play that day, which I don't believe.
And some people said John Hammond asked him to fire him.
I really don't know. I never -- I have never been able -- now that's one thing I really don't know. I don't think anybody knows, really.
Lester never said anything to you?
